# iru_device (Resource)

Manages an enrolled Iru device: its asset tag, assigned user, blueprint and tags.

Devices enroll through Iru, so this resource **cannot create devices**: bring one under Terraform with an import block, `terraform import`, or `terraform query`. **Destroy only removes the device from Terraform state**; it never deletes, unenrolls or erases the device.

Attributes left out of the configuration are not managed: Terraform keeps the imported value and changes made in Iru don't show as drift. An update sends only the attributes that changed. The device name can't be set through this API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Devices can't be created: import an enrolled device (see Import below), then
# manage these fields.
resource "iru_device" "loaner" {
  asset_tag    = "IT-0042"
  user_id      = data.iru_user.alex.id
  blueprint_id = iru_blueprint.core.id
  tags         = ["loaner", "engineering"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `asset_tag` (String) Asset tag. Set to `""` to clear it.
- `blueprint_id` (String) Blueprint the device is assigned to. Changing it moves the device, and its library items change with it.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tag names. When set, the device's tags are replaced with exactly this set; `[]` clears them.
- `user_id` (String) ID of the assigned user (see `iru_user`). Set to `""` to unassign.

### Read-Only

- `blueprint_name` (String) Blueprint name.
- `id` (String) Device ID.
- `model` (String) Hardware model.
- `name` (String) Device name.
- `os_version` (String) OS version.
- `platform` (String) `Mac`, `iPhone`, `iPad` or `AppleTV`.
- `serial_number` (String) Serial number.
- `user_email` (String) Assigned user's email.
- `user_name` (String) Assigned user's name.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = iru_device.loaner
  identity = {
    id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the object in Iru.

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = iru_device.loaner
  id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Devices are imported by their ID. Destroy only removes them from state.
terraform import iru_device.loaner 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
